ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels, with high-intensity areas concentrated on distal lobe tips and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous low-intensity (black) region extending from the peduncle through the central lobes. Lateral lobes exhibit high-intensity (white) streaking and mottling beginning at approximately 60% distance from the center and reaching maximum intensity at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute pixel angle of approximately 55 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the distal 30% of both trailing edges; central sections of the trailing edge exhibit a smoother, continuous pixel boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave curvature of the trailing edge meeting at a central point, with distal tips exhibiting an upward and outward convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible high-contrast white circular ring (approximate diameter 15-20 pixels) in the left-central lobe area. Multiple smaller white circular pixel clusters distributed across the right-central lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel high-intensity linear marks on the outer-left lobe surface; single vertical high-contrast linear streak on the right lobe interior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular scarring consistent with parasitic attachment on both lobes; linear rake-mark abrasions on the left lobe; jagged pixel termination at the extreme right distal tip indicating potential minor tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity white fringe pattern specifically localized along the trailing edge border of the left lobe, distinct from the broader mottling on the lobe surface.
